title: Prove conditional uniform R437 COPY contract and complete relative cost
body:
This follow-up to #3936 proves a uniform local rank-seven COPY reduction for the nine current R437 frames and derives its complete **conditional** good/fallback bill. The requested uniform physical supplier proof remains incomplete; this package makes the missing integration precise and claims no admission or frontier change.

The new rank-specific Cauchy–Binet/Jacobi argument gives delta_7 <= min(1,448(q-1)/(q(q-2))) and <449/q for q>=450. Classification is shared by every high lift and unit ancestor weighting. The original plan pays `9872*f` ordered ADDs on the good branch; fallback has at most 49911 main/half-reset children of width <=f. This yields `T(7f,w)+delta_7*49911*max T(j,w)`, plus local scans and explicitly retained encoded preparation, under the stated completed-callee/refinement premises.

An alternate all-class exact-ring construction is also fully invoiced: one reversed 7f child, `41832*f` ordered ADDs and **41832 ordinary interchanges**. Those reverse-order adapters cannot be discarded or assumed to fit the original local tariff. The resulting failed implication is not an impossibility theorem against the original caller.

Validation: all seven registered Python 3.12 commands pass. New independent algebra covers all nine projectors and 45 modular contexts; independent nullspace and minor checks include 92112 complete small-GL matrices. Authenticated original plan probes and an actual encoded numerical-component probe pass. The latter uses actual COPY515 and a declared synthetic rank26 ancestor, 1664->182, four coefficients, restored program/prefix/numerical state and three rejecting source controls, with runtime host decoding disabled. It is not a full R437 Catalogue, payload/stock or physical CALL/RETURN test. Actual optimized Git-free CLI corruption controls pass. Receipts, source pins, command log and validation hashes are included.

PR[3936](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3936) CI was checked first: initial run 39202988286 and current-head run 39205477701 succeeded. Current head e54c649865d737fe08edd4312a234cd186317db4 differs only by the P112 workflow repair; scientific bytes are unchanged. Canonical main 20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90 and revision-6 priorities were refreshed unchanged at checkpoints. This explicit donor task refines independent-moment. Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3936#issuecomment-6260449978. Overlap coverage is partial.

Credit: ai-nanachi/#3647, Sagar Thakrar/#3700, Ali Romman/#1043 and retained R437/native lineage; alephnan/#1627, Adam Gall/#2088, Ross Richardson/#1704 for complete streams; eumemic and Jose Manuel/#2234 for split bases/common labels; David Arias/#2753, Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml/#2809/#2899/#2915, Nick Petalas/#2808 and retained physical/primitive lineage. zxv/#3690 already provides a finite R437 adapter and controlled rank34 return at older source 36ff441; our unchanged-selected-Catalogue 659/661 guard does not refute that adapter. Jose Manuel/#3562 and Sagar Thakrar/#3724 already supply conditional ordinary retuning/arithmetic checks. Full notices and Apache-2.0 license are retained. New proofs/code/checks by Chris R / Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent human or formal-kernel review.

Next: refresh #3690's finite adapter at the current a24f9ff/OQ4 source, authenticate its actual rank26 ancestor and rank7 COPY in the complete physical ordinary/native/router cohort, then prove uniform preparation, continuation and visited-cell reserve. The local matrix proof and synthetic probe do not discharge that obligation.

Reproduce: python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/r437-uniform-copy-reduction. No fresh selected cold replay or native rebuild is claimed.

Published commit 364701494bc3d726806a15d4d1d4b547c1e0f9d5 passes exact package/replay-input byte and source-history verification (29 new package files plus 25 canonical live inputs), package metadata/pins, and whitespace checks.
